note: Every term here is one the examiner reports record candidates confusing or misusing (2021-2025), or one a confused term depends on. The sense is ours, written to match the syllabus wording. Use it exactly, everywhere.

terms.sense: Primary storage the processor accesses directly: RAM and ROM.
terms.homonym_warning: Not storage. Files kept between sessions are in (secondary) storage.

terms.sense: Secondary storage: devices that keep data when the power is off (disk, SSD, optical disc).
terms.homonym_warning: Not memory.

terms.sense: Values as stored and processed, without meaning attached.
terms.homonym_warning: Information is data given meaning in a context.

terms.sense: Data given meaning in a context.
terms.homonym_warning: Not a synonym for data.

terms.sense: A unit of data with a header (addresses, sequence number) and a payload, sent across a network.
terms.homonym_warning: Never "package".

terms.sense: The number of pixels in an image, width by height.
terms.homonym_warning: Distinct from screen resolution (the display) and sampling resolution (sound).

terms.sense: The number of bits used to store the colour of each pixel; also called bit depth.
terms.homonym_warning: Distinct from image resolution.

terms.sense: The number of sound samples taken per second, in hertz.
terms.homonym_warning: Distinct from sampling resolution.

terms.sense: How many bits each sound sample is stored in.
terms.homonym_warning: Distinct from sampling rate and from image resolution.

terms.sense: The list of drawing objects that make up one vector image, each with its properties.
terms.homonym_warning: Not the library of every shape available.

terms.sense: One shape in a vector graphic, stored as a command with properties.
terms.homonym_warning: One entry in the drawing list.

terms.sense: Compression that permanently removes some data to reduce file size.
terms.homonym_warning: The original cannot be rebuilt exactly.

terms.sense: Compression from which the original file can be rebuilt exactly.
terms.homonym_warning: Run-length encoding is one lossless method.

terms.sense: Binary Coded Decimal: each denary digit stored as its own 4-bit binary group.
terms.homonym_warning: Not the same as converting the whole number to binary.

terms.sense: A binary representation of signed integers in which the most significant bit has a negative place value.
terms.homonym_warning: Read the MSB as negative.

terms.sense: The result of a calculation needs more bits than the register holds.
An area of memory that holds data temporarily while it is moved between devices that work at different speeds.
terms.homonym_warning: A buffer stores; it does not send.

terms.sense: A computer system built into a larger device to perform a dedicated task.
terms.homonym_warning: Embedded is about being part of the device, not about control.

terms.sense: A device that produces physical movement or action from a signal.
terms.homonym_warning: The microprocessor decides; the actuator acts.

terms.sense: The output of a control system affecting its next input.
terms.homonym_warning: Not user opinion.

terms.sense: The register that stores the memory address of the instruction the processor will fetch next.
terms.homonym_warning: It does not count instructions.

terms.sense: The part of the CPU that decodes instructions and sends control signals.
terms.homonym_warning: Not the whole CPU.

terms.sense: A signal to the processor that an event needs attention, handled by an interrupt service routine.
terms.homonym_warning: Each cause has its own routine.

terms.sense: The operand is the value itself (#n).
terms.homonym_warning: Direct addressing uses the contents of the address given.

terms.sense: The address used is the address given plus the contents of the index register.
terms.homonym_warning: Add, then look up.

terms.sense: Bits are moved left or right; bits shifted out are lost and zeros enter.
terms.homonym_warning: Not cyclic.

terms.sense: Bits shifted out of one end re-enter at the other.
terms.homonym_warning: Not logical.

terms.sense: A shift that preserves the sign bit, copying it on a right shift.
Programs supplied with an operating system to maintain the computer, such as a disk formatter or defragmenter.
Rearranging the parts of files on a disk so each file is stored contiguously.
terms.homonym_warning: The file size does not change.

terms.sense: A collection of pre-written, tested routines a program can use.
terms.homonym_warning: Not a way of organising files.

terms.sense: An automatic check that data is reasonable and follows rules (range, format, length, presence, existence, type, check digit).
terms.homonym_warning: Does not prove data is correct.

terms.sense: A check that data has been copied or transferred accurately (double entry, visual check, parity, checksum).
terms.homonym_warning: Does not prove data is correct.

terms.sense: Data being accurate, complete and consistent.
terms.homonym_warning: Distinct from security and privacy.

terms.sense: Protecting data from loss, corruption or unauthorised access.
terms.homonym_warning: Distinct from integrity.

terms.sense: A message that tricks the user into revealing details or visiting a fake site.
terms.homonym_warning: Needs the user to act.

terms.sense: Redirecting a user to a fake website without their action, for example by altering DNS.
terms.homonym_warning: The user typed the right address.

terms.sense: Software whose licence (Free Software Foundation) gives the freedom to run, study, change and share it.
terms.homonym_warning: Not merely free of charge; that is freeware.

terms.sense: Software given away free of charge, without the right to see or change the source.
terms.homonym_warning: Not free software.

terms.sense: A set of records about one entity in a relational database.
terms.homonym_warning: A database contains tables.

terms.sense: A row in a table: one record.
terms.homonym_warning: A row in a table, not in a database.

terms.sense: An attribute in one table that is the primary key of another table, linking the two.
Removing unnecessary detail to focus on what matters for the problem.
terms.homonym_warning: Not decomposition.

terms.sense: Breaking a problem into sub-problems, leading to modules.
terms.homonym_warning: A problem, not a program, is decomposed.

terms.sense: The name given to a variable, constant, array or module.
terms.homonym_warning: An identifier is not a literal: "Total" in quotes is a string.

terms.sense: A value written directly in the code, such as 5 or "Yes".
terms.homonym_warning: Strings and characters take quotation marks.

terms.sense: A value passed into a procedure or function through its header.
terms.homonym_warning: Values arrive as parameters, not by INPUT.

terms.sense: A module that returns a single value and is used in an expression.
terms.homonym_warning: It RETURNs; it is never CALLed.

terms.sense: A module called as a statement; it does not return a value through its name.
terms.homonym_warning: Called with CALL.

terms.sense: A loop that runs a known number of times (FOR ... NEXT).
A loop that ends on a condition: pre-condition (WHILE) or post-condition (REPEAT ... UNTIL).
An ADT in which the last item added is the first removed (push, pop).
terms.homonym_warning: Not a queue.

terms.sense: An ADT in which the first item added is the first removed (enqueue at the rear, dequeue at the front).
terms.homonym_warning: Not a stack.

terms.sense: In an array implementation, a variable holding the index of an element (top, front, rear, start, next).
terms.homonym_warning: It holds an index, not a data value.

terms.sense: Valid data at the limits of the acceptable range.
terms.homonym_warning: Boundary data tests either side of a limit.
